primary_development_contrast: M2 minus M0, smaller loss is better
primary_metric: planet-balanced IS95 divided by common M0 predictive SD; conditional weighted loss
scored_unit: each published TESS timing; one origin per comparison, equal event weights within planet
fit_unit: unclipped 20-day span-capped visit means, shared T0-P covariance within planet
bootstrap: joint host resampling across fitting and scoring, refitting M1-M3
decision_rule: conditional improvement if 95% percentile interval of paired loss difference lies below zero, worsening if above zero, otherwise inconclusive

release_transfer.status: nearest-release-availability proxy: training timing file uploaded after DRC forecast; individual prior availability unknown

chronological.status: observation-date proxy: early DRC events can predate release, and timing availability predates neither training cutoff nor release by verified evidence

secondary_release_proxy.status: later-published outcome proxy, used only as calibration-sample sensitivity

limitations: All outcomes inspected development material; none of these comparisons is an untouched test
Covariance reconstructions retain C3 source-fit mismatch flags; rho zero is a sensitivity, not a missing-data default
Outcome-error and exposure independence remain assumptions requiring sprint2 validation
Metadata opportunity counts are not measured/transit-detection counts
No calibration or outcome-scale tolerance is certified for protected evaluation by a proxy alone
